summary: Frontend-only verification of the newly added area-input forms on the /visual-agent-demo Buyer Insights and Seller Insights panes. All acceptance criteria passed: inputs and submit buttons present with correct data-testids and labels, headers update to reflect typed city, live CREA DDF stats render (Kelowna active_count=2092, Surrey active_comps=4397, both with 'live' freshness pill), and out-of-area city ('Zzznotacity') does not crash the UI.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Visual-agent-demo hero avatar takes ~10-20s to load (lazy chunk). Always click Pause before interacting with scenario tabs. New testids to remember: buyerinsights-area-input, buyerinsights-area-submit ('Get insights'), sellerlookup-area-input, sellerlookup-area-submit ('Get seller insights'). Buyer header format: 'Buyer snapshot · <City>'. Seller header format: 'Comparable actives · <City>'. Backend /api/insights?city=Kelowna returns ~2092 active listings; Surrey returns ~4397.
